items.question: Why should initiation of paśu be avoided with all effort?
premises: tasmāt marks consequence from prior verse
paśordīkṣāṃ names the object to avoid
items.inference: The verse commands complete avoidance of paśu initiation as a necessary consequence.
uncertainties: exact prior verse referenced by tasmāt is not supplied
items.plain_english: Therefore, with all effort, one should avoid the initiation of a paśu.
